'''Santo''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He had a hooked scar over his left brow. Santo worked for a rebel band made up of escapees from the [[Deathblock]] and led by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Warburton]]. Unknown to the rest of the rebels, he began cooperating with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With his cooperation, the Imperials were able to discover their base in the [[sub-facility]].

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Santo was giving information to an Imperial [[Major/Legends|major]] and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TX-567]] when he was encountered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], disguised as an Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].<ref name="JH119" /> He did not recognize Skywalker later when he came to the sub-facility searching for help in escaping Tol Ado, but Skywalker identified him due to the moon-shaped scar above his left eye.<ref name="JH117">''[[Jedi's Honor]]'', scenario 117</ref> Warburton ordered Skywalker and his companions, [[Erling Tredway]] and [[Sidney Shortfang]] to participate in an ambush of Imperial sources to prove that they were not [[Spy/Legends|spies]], but the battle was a disaster due to Santo's feeding of information to the Imperials. When Warburton wanted to execute Tredway for his poor performance in the fight against the Imperials, Skywalker told the rebels of Santo's cooperation with Imperials. Santo protested, but Warburton had him executed for betraying the group.<ref name="JH133">''[[Jedi's Honor]]'', scenario 133</ref><ref name="JH123">''[[Jedi's Honor]]'', scenario 123</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Santo was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''. The exact manner in which Skywalker tells the rebels of the sub-facility about Santo's treachery depends on the reader's choices during the battle with the Imperials. If Skywalker allows Erling Tredway to botch the ambush, then Skywalker reveals Santo's treachery directly to Warburton. If he stops Tredway from interfering, then he reveals this information to [[Tormey]], a lieutenant of Warburton. In either case, Santo is discovered and executed by Warburton for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
